userRequest: Check ALL major model providers for new model releases, version updates, deprecations, and capability changes. Build Atlas first. Read packages/atlas/graph/capabilities-and-models/model-provider-product.yaml, model-provider-version.yaml, and model-version-defaults.yaml, then list packages/atlas/graph/catalog-meta/claims/model-version-*. Search the web for each provider individually: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT/o-series, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Meta Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, Alibaba Qwen, Amazon Nova, Cohere Command, Together AI, Fireworks, and Groq. Compare latest findings against graph records and existing model-version-update issues. For each new model or significant update, dedupe with gh issue list --label model-version-update --search <model-name>; create a real issue with exact model ID/version, provider/API family, release date if known, docs/announcement links, context, capabilities, pricing, cross-provider availability, graph changes needed, and transport-adapter proxy support. If graph YAML changes are needed, branch model-versions/daily-YYYY-MM-DD, commit, create one PR against staging, and rebuild Atlas. Print a comprehensive summary table covering every provider.
